 2                                          FACTUAL BACKGROUND

 3                  INTERNATIONAL DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT BETWEEN

 4                                      FORTINET AND COMSEC

 5            14.   On August 9, 2004, Fortinet International and Comsec Ltd. entered into an

 6   International Distributor Agreement (the “Distributor Agreement”).

 7            15.   As part of the Distributor Agreement, Fortinet International agreed to provide

 8   certain content security products and services, and Comsec agreed to be appointed as a

 9   nonexclusive marketer and distributor of the products and services in a specific territory.

10            16.   For each Product Comsec ordered, Comsec agreed to pay Fortinet International the

11   current MSRP less a distributor’s discount.

12            17.   The payment terms indicated that Comsec would pay Fortinet International net

13   forty-five days from the date of Fortinet International’s invoice, in U.S. dollars, and either by check

14   or money order, wire transfer, or an irrevocable Letter of Credit. Comsec would be responsible for

15   all bank fees and charges.

16            18.   The Distributor Agreement also provided upon a dispute between the parties as to

17   the Distributor Agreement, that “If any action or proceeding is commenced to enforce this

18   Agreement or any right arising in connection with this Agreement, the prevailing party in such

19   action or proceeding shall be entitled to recover from the other party the reasonable attorneys fees,

20   costs and expenses incurred by such prevailing party in connection with such action or proceeding.”

21            19.   Comsec was obligated to pay interest on all amounts not paid when due at 1.5% per

22   month.

23            20.   The Distributor Agreement provided that Fortinet International had the contractual

24   right to change payment terms, including to require Comsec to provide an Irrevocable Letter of

25   Credit at any time if Comsec’s financial condition or payment recorded indicated it was needed.

26            21.   The Distributor Agreement was for one year, with the term to automatically renew

27   unless either party gave sixty days written notice of their decision to not extend the Agreement.

28            22.   The Distributor Agreement could be terminated by either party with ninety days
                                                   -3-

 1   prior written notice.

 2           23.    Comsec and Fortinet International were independent contractors of each other and

 3   had a non-exclusive relationship.

 4           24.    The Distributor Agreement is confidential and will be filed with the Court under

 5   seal.

 6           25.    Fortinet International fully performed its obligations under the Distributor

 7   Agreement.

 8           26.    Sometime after the Distributor Agreement was signed and in or around 2019,

 9   Fortinet became the party to issue invoices to Comsec and to provide the security products and

10   services to Comsec.

11           27.    Comsec and Fortinet were independent contractors of each other and had a non-

12   exclusive relationship.

13           28.    Fortinet fully performed its obligations under the Distributor Agreement.

14                                    HUB’S GUARANTY TO FORTINET

15           29.    Comsec failed to pay multiple invoices that came due and prompted Fortinet to seek

16   additional assurances of payment.

17           30.    HUB is the parent company of Comsec.

18           31.    In February 2023, HUB entered into a Guaranty with Fortinet.

19           32.    The Guaranty states that Fortinet has extended credit to Comsec and Comsec wishes

20   to increase its credit limit under the Distributor Agreement.

21           33.    The Guaranty provides Fortinet will increase Comsec’s credit limit only if HUB

22   guarantees the faithful payment performance of all the terms and conditions thereof.

23           34.    The Guaranty states, “The Guarantor hereby unconditionally and irrevocably

24   guarantees full, prompt and complete payment by the Buyer, when due, of all of its obligations

25   under the International Distributor Agreement and any purchase order issued pursuant to the

26   agreement.”

27           35.    The Guaranty further states that HUB agrees to make Fortinet whole, including by

28   paying costs and fees, “The Guarantor agrees to indemnify [Fortinet] for any and all reasonable
                                                    -4-
          Case 3:25-cv-09415          Document 1        Filed 10/31/25     Page 5 of 35



 1   costs and expenses (including attorneys’ fees and expenses) incurred by [Fortinet] in enforcing any

 2   rights under this Agreement.”

 3           36.     The Guaranty also “waives . . . any rights they may have of first requiring [Fortinet]

 4   to proceed against, or enforce the Guaranty, or claim payment from the Buyer or any other person,

 5   firm or corporation.”

 6           37.     The Guaranty “shall remain in full force and effect until the payment, liabilities, and

 7   obligations of [Comsec] under the International Distributor Agreement have been discharged and

 8   performed in full.”

 9           38.     HUB “waives the making of any demand for payment upon [Comsec] and the giving

10   by [Fortinet] of any notices to which [HUB] might otherwise be entitled by law.”
